title: Chunk SDPA reference to avoid CPU OOM in ring-joint accuracy tests
body:
## Summary
The non-chunked `F.scaled_dot_product_attention` reference in `torch_joint_sdpa_reference` materializes the full `[B, H, Sq, Sk]` attention matrix in fp32 on CPU, OOMing host RAM on the MLA configs. Replaced with a head- and Q-sequence-chunked version that produces the same output without ever holding the full matrix.

## Test plan
- [x] [![(Blackhole) e2e tests](https://github.com/tenstorrent/tt-metal/actions/workflows/blackhole-e2e-tests.yaml/badge.svg?branch=skrstic/sdpa-chunked-reference)](https://github.com/tenstorrent/tt-metal/actions/runs/25004297790)
